description:
Found 2026-11-15 (bitstring split experiments). On fz-nml.11 31823421d both are 'lower/unbound: unresolved direct runtime callee'. fz-rs7.7 recorded them as absent and out of its scope. Elixir: bit_size/1 takes a bitstring and returns its bit count (guard-safe); binary_part/3 takes a binary, start and length (negative length counts back), raises ArgumentError out of range, guard-safe. bit_size's domain is bitstring, so this lands after fz-sc8.30 (the bitstring/binary split). binary_part of a large binary should return a view (fz-nml.1), not a copy. Acceptance: oracle fixture covering bodies and guards, partial bitstrings for bit_size, the negative-length and out-of-range cases for binary_part, three paths.

bit_size/1 moved to fz-sc8.237 (2026-11-15), which Macro.escape (fz-sc8.225) needs first; this ticket keeps binary_part/3.

2026-11-20: fz-mue.5 adds :erlang.binary_part/3, so Kernel.binary_part/3 can delegate to it, as Elixir does. Signal: tools/floor/programs/08b_binary_part.exs fails today with error[lower/unbound] 'unresolved direct runtime callee binary_part/3' at 5:12 (Binary Handling, develop b241f0348).

Re-test on develop de4ef6a3b (Elixir Parity, 2026-11-24; user-approved update): narrowed. :erlang.binary_part/3 exists (lib/erlang.fz:188, from fz-mue.5). What remains: Kernel.binary_part/3 delegates to it in bodies, and binary_part/3 works in guards. Today a body call gives "unresolved direct runtime callee" and a guard gives "guard call binary_part/3 is unresolved". Evidence: Elixir Parity's fresh/report.md.

comments.text: OTP json.erl parity (fz-mue) needs this; reproducer from the faithful port: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/punch/04_erlang_binary_part.fz

Board cleanup approved by the user, verbatim "fz-9e2 cleanup approved" (in Binary Handling's session, 2026-11-19). Folded with fz-mue.5's binary_part: one implementation of binary_part/3, owned by whichever ticket lands first; the other closes against it. Landing it also unblocks tools/floor's 08b_binary_part program.
Narrowed to bodies (user: 'Land body now, guards as ticket', relayed by Elixir Parity 2026-11-24). Guards: fz-mue.63.

title: Kernel has binary_part/3 in bodies, as in Elixir
